text.tspan: Upgrading a cluster: one minor version at a time
• kubelet: up to 3 minors older than the API server, never newer
• cordon = no new pods · drain = also evict (respects PDBs)
• hangs? a PDB can't be met (minAvailable 1 with 1 replica)
• EKS: managed node groups drain for you; Karpenter replaces drifted nodes
